summary_en: Musashino Bank raised its interim dividend per share to ¥43.00 for the period ending September 30, 2026, and revised upward the fiscal year 2027 full-year dividend forecast to ¥86.00 per share from ¥82.00, reflecting strong earnings performance and the bank's progressive dividend policy targeting a 40% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Musashino Bank's Board of Directors approved an interim dividend of ¥43.00 per share for the interim period ending September 30, 2026, an increase of ¥16.33 per share from the previously forecast ¥26.67 per share (on a post-stock split basis). The total interim dividend payout was ¥4,183 million. The bank also revised upward its dividend forecast for fiscal year 2027 (ending March 31, 2027) to ¥86.00 per share from ¥82.00, with a year-end dividend increased to ¥43.00 per share.

The bank's basic dividend policy is to achieve sustainable profit growth as a regional financial institution while maintaining and strengthening its financial position through progressive dividend increases. The target payout ratio is approximately 40% of net income attributable to parent company shareholders. The dividend increase reflects the bank's comprehensive assessment of recent business performance and its commitment to rewarding shareholder support.

Note: The bank implemented a 1-for-3 stock split effective April 1, 2026. Prior-period dividend figures have been presented on both an actual pre-split basis and an adjusted post-split basis for comparison.
